optimization-loop-result.stop_reason: Ten consecutive attempted changes failed to establish a repeatable 1% improvement (paired-run 95% lower bounds all below 1%). Combined candidate additionally regressed in independent confirmation. No further experiments or soak scheduled.
optimization-loop-result.limitation: Random production shuffles and machine/filesystem jitter cause high variance. Per-trial 32-game arms are screening samples, not proof that the candidate is universally faster or slower. Statistical checks compare means of four-game runs, not 32 independent games. No outlier was dropped. This does not establish that other architectural optimizations cannot reach 50 ms.
optimization-loop-result.measurement: Game dispatch through complete evidence hash, serialization, schema validation, durable writes, progress publication. Phase timers may overlap and cannot be summed. Release binaries rebuilt for each candidate. Source snapshots restored for each alternate arm, so manifests identify measured source. Normal randomness and all four game positions included.

performance.measurement_boundary: Each game: dispatch before engine handle creation through canonical hashing, required event/decision XML, XSD validation, atomic evidence file fsync/rename and progress fsync. End-to-end: command entry, configuration validation, cold startup, all four games, sideboarding, aggregation, summary/report/progress persistence and host shutdown. This final benchmark timing-metadata update is outside that interval. Component timers may overlap across the supervisor and host and are not additive.
